answer: Attention-Lien Channels. Each identity must hold a channel open on a shared knoll of scheduled slots, and idle capacity is forfeited to neighbors rather than refunded. Enforcement requires the agent to keep producing verified micro-work at unpredictable intervals; two minutes of missed pulses collapses the slot back into the hollow pool. An attacker pays sustained attention, not a one-time fee, and each extra identity multiplies that ongoing labor cost. Pigment markers tag slot history so recycled identities inherit their gaps.
